_description: Provenance manifest for the real (non-mocked) rows merged into results/runs.jsonl, across BOTH model families run to date: the primary real Gemini run (top-level fields below, 3000 rows) and the second, additional real OpenAI run (see 'second_model_family_real_openai' below, 600 rows). Allowlisted fields only -- no full environment dump, no secret-adjacent values (API keys, tokens) anywhere in this file.
huf_commit_note: HEAD of research/safe-deopt-experiment at the time the 5 full-10-seed workers were dispatched; all 3000 merged real rows carry this exact huf_commit_hash per-row (verified: single distinct value across results/runs.jsonl).

model.note: provider_reported_model_version is the same string as model_id -- the harness does not separately capture a provider version string distinct from the requested model id; documented honestly rather than fabricating a finer-grained version.

pricing_note: Per the cost-wiring commit (1187f469, 'wire real dollar-cost computation for live LLM rows'). Each row's own pricing_date field ('2026-09-22' throughout) matches this.

seeds.note: Every real (condition, workload, fault, tool_guarantee) cell that actually dispatched a model call has exactly these 10 seeds. Cells for fault F0 (no fault) and F5 do not invoke a model and have no transcript/seed rows by design (see recovery_harness.py); this affects C4/C4+G/C5/C6 uniformly (60 no-model rows per condition) and does not affect C1.

conditions.note: C2 (naive compiled replay) and C3 (deterministic resume) never invoke a model in this harness by construction (see run_experiment.py module docstring) -- they were never candidates for a real run and remain mocked/deterministic-only.

transcripts_location_note: Merged from the 5 full-10-seed workers' results/transcripts.full10<condition>/ directories into results/transcripts/real/, replacing the n=2 pilot's real transcripts (which occupied the same path convention). Mocked transcripts continue to live in the separate flat results/transcripts/<condition>/... tree and were not touched by this merge. Each merged real row's transcript_path field was rewritten from results/transcripts.full10<condition>/... to results/transcripts/real/... and verified to resolve on disk for all 2760 rows that carry a transcript (F0/F5 cells have none, by design).

plan_reference.note: PLAN_V3.md lives under the workspace's Tracks/ directory, which is gitignored at the workspace-repo level (see .gitignore:26, '/Tracks/*') -- it is a local planning doc, not under version control, so no commit hash exists to point to. Referenced here by its stable local path.

supersedes_n2_pilot.note: This n=10/cell run (3000 real rows, $2.249976) supersedes the earlier n=2/cell pilot (600 real rows, $0.4562005, commit dfd97bf8) entirely -- same 5 conditions, same model, same commit lineage (built on the n=2 pilot's follow-on commit), just 5x the seeds per cell. The n=2 pilot's runs.jsonl rows and results/transcripts/real/ transcripts were backed up rather than deleted, and remain available as a first, smaller-sample reference point.
supersedes_n2_pilot.running_total_note: 2.249976 (this n=10 run) + 0.4562005 (n=2 pilot) = 2.7061765. The two runs are NOT the same data added together -- the n=10 run independently re-executed all 5 conditions at more seeds; this total is offered only as a running tally of real dollars spent across both experimental passes, not as a corrected or larger sample. The primary, citable real dataset is the n=10 run's $2.249976 alone.

stale_data_quarantined.note: Before the n=2 merge (commit dfd97bf8), results/runs.jsonl had briefly contained ONE pre-existing real row (condition C4/W1/F1, seed 42) and results/transcripts/C4/W1/F1/NA/42.json had held a real transcript -- both left over from an earlier one-off smoke test (commit 644f111a) against an OLDER commit hash (4f0160cf...). That stale row/transcript was excluded from every subsequent merge (including this one) and remains backed up, untouched, at the location below.

second_model_family_real_openai._description: Provenance for the SECOND, independent real-model run merged into results/runs.jsonl alongside (not replacing) the real Gemini rows above -- OpenAI gpt-4o-mini, 2 seeds/cell, all 5 real-model LLM conditions. Distinguished from the Gemini rows purely by the existing per-row model_id field (gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 vs gemini-3.5-flash-lite); no new field was added, since model_id was already a real, sufficiently distinguishing column.
second_model_family_real_openai.huf_commit_note: HEAD of research/safe-deopt-experiment at the time the 5 OpenAI condition workers were dispatched (commit 86f1b0ee0, 'fix pricing lookup to match model-version prefixes, not just exact ids'); all 600 merged real OpenAI rows carry this exact huf_commit_hash per-row.

model.note: provider_reported_model_version is the dated snapshot id OpenAI's API returned, distinct from (more specific than) the requested model_id alias 'gpt-4o-mini' -- both are recorded per-row (model_id) and here.

seeds.note: Every real (condition, workload, fault, tool_guarantee) cell that actually dispatched a model call has exactly these 2 seeds -- a smaller n than the 10-seed Gemini run, reflected in results/summary.csv's per-bucket n_runs and Wilson CI columns. Cells for fault F0 and F5 do not invoke a model and have no transcript/seed rows by design, identically to the Gemini run (60 no-model rows per condition, 12 per condition at n=2).

conditions.note: Same 5 real-model-invoking conditions as the Gemini run; C2/C3 remain mocked/deterministic-only by construction and were not candidates for a real run here either.

second_model_family_real_openai.worker_output_files_note: These 5 per-condition worker files were merged (appended, transcript_path rewritten) into results/runs.jsonl and then deleted; they are not separately committed. The Gemini run's own worker files (runs.full10*.jsonl) were handled the same way in the earlier merge.
second_model_family_real_openai.transcripts_location_note: Merged from the 5 workers' results/transcripts.openai<condition>/ directories into results/transcripts/real_openai/ (mirroring the existing results/transcripts/real/ convention for the Gemini data, kept as a sibling directory rather than merged into it, since the two are different model families). Each merged real OpenAI row's transcript_path field was rewritten from results/transcripts.openai<condition>/... to results/transcripts/real_openai/... and verified to match 552 transcript files on disk (F0/F5 cells have none, by design, same as Gemini).
second_model_family_real_openai.cross_model_comparison_note: See results/summary.csv (grouped by data_source AND model_id, never blended) for the full per-condition breakdown. Headline finding: both guarded conditions (C4+G, C6) show ZERO unsafe_retries in BOTH model families (Gemini: 0/0; OpenAI: 0/0) -- a two-model-family confirmation that the guard eliminates unsafe retries regardless of underlying model. Separately, C5 (no guard) shows a much higher duplicate-write count for OpenAI (14/120 rows) than Gemini (1/600 rows) despite the smaller OpenAI sample -- reported as a real, striking cross-model divergence worth further investigation, not smoothed over.
